exemptions.report:
ERROR: deslag detected an exemption that does not hold!

deslag.toml has md.allow[0], which exempts a sentence of docs/adr/0001.md from `banned_chars`. It fails: [md] excludes docs/adr/0001.md by "/docs/adr/**", and an entry applies only to the files its own section selects. Tell the human that this pattern drops the file; whether the entry or the pattern changes is theirs to choose.

The quote: "We chose the parser — a dated record."
The reason: "A decision record keeps its words."

An entry that does not hold may be deleted; that only tightens the check. Never write or change an entry: only a human exempts a sentence. Leave the sentence as it is, and give the human its text and a reason. Rewording a sentence only to get past a lint is no fix.
